output.scope_note: The paper reports EIS ionic conductivities of solid Li3PS4 (pristine and solvent-recrystallized β-Li3PS4) and the Li3PS4·2NMF intermediate at 25 °C.

records.synthesis_method: commercial powder (NEI Corporation) with NMF dissolution/recrystallization studied; pristine material as purchased
records.evidence_quote: were determined to be 2.34∙10-5 S∙cm-1 and 2.18∙10-5 S∙cm-1 at 25 °C, respectively
records.notes: Value for pristine β-Li3PS4 (first of the two values in the sentence). Activation energy 0.38 eV from the sentence 'the activation energies of both samples are with 0.38 and 0.20 eV'. Pressed powder measured under 50 MPa.

records.synthesis_method: dissolution in N-methylformamide and recrystallization (heated to 240 °C)
records.evidence_quote: were determined to be 2.34∙10-5 S∙cm-1 and 2.18∙10-5 S∙cm-1 at 25 °C, respectively
records.notes: Value for recrystallized β-Li3PS4 (second value in the sentence). Activation energy 0.20 eV from the same activation-energy sentence. Paper states both values are the same within experimental error. Material name in the sentence is written 'βLi3PS4' after PDF line-break.

records.evidence_quote: a conductivity value of 1.66∙10-9 S∙cm-1 at 25 °C was calculated
records.notes: NMF-solvate intermediate phase, not a conventional electrolyte; value derived from a two-R/CPE fit. Activation barrier 0.70 eV from 'The significantly higher activation barrier of 0.70 eV'.
